title: Battle of Zonchio
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Zonchio", at revision 1379397759, opens: "The naval Battle of Zonchio took place on four separate days: 12, 20, 22, and 25 August 1499. It was a part of the Ottoman–Venetian War of 1499–1503." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2351714, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1499 naval battle of the Ottoman–Venetian War of 1499–1503". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
